name: print-social-astro-physics-conference-posts-cream-navy-orbit-diagrams
title: 'Astro Physics' conference pack with cream, navy and orange orbit-line diagrams and rotated serif type
whatItMeans: Sophisticated and thematic; orbit-line diagrams double as both scientific illustration and elegant background decoration.
whatItIs: Five square posts in cream, orange, navy and pink, with thin orbit-line diagrams and circles as recurring background motifs, bold rotated serif headlines ('ANNUAL CONFERENCE', 'PHYSICS'), speaker photo cards with quote marks, a schedule grid and pill labels for topics (Maths, Physics, Matter).
techniques: Use orbit-line diagrams as a recurring thematic background motif.
Rotate large serif words vertically for editorial flair.
Label topics as small rounded pills for quick scanning.

vocabulary.definition: Concentric elliptical lines suggesting astronomical motion.
Text set vertically rather than horizontally.
